text:
Zoe: 2-min sync  GA checklist for Ripple routing. Need owners for SLA signoff, billing-smoke, docs/runbook, canary cadence, and dashboarding. Who takes which?
Marco: Ill own SLA validation + perf runs. Suggest p99 <= 200ms hosted GA, availability 99.95%. For Dedicated we should promise throughput floors and 99.9% avail.
Leah: I can do docs + billing examples. Will add a short "how to read your invoice" section. Need a small billing-smoke script.
sre-bot: I can schedule canary and oncall handoff. Proposed canary: warmup 45m @2%, 8h @10%, 16h @40%, then 24h @100% if stable. Auto-rollback if p99 > 280ms or errors >0.2% for 5m.
Marco: Test plan: synthetic 30m at 40k QPS (measure p95/p99 + GPU tail), plus 6h replay at production mix. Pass = p99 <=200ms and error-rate <0.08% sustained.
Leah: Billing-smoke checklist:
```
- run 150 requests across seq lengths (16, 256, 1024)
- ensure invoice lines: model, tokens, dedicated surcharge
- verify per-request token charge math
- simulate trial org -> 200 requests -> check invoice
```
finance-bot: Sent invoice template and monthly cost calculator to Leah. Remember to include token-decay rates for long sequences.
Marco: Observability asks: per-route p95/p99, request-size histogram, KV cache hit-rate, token-cost-per-request metric, and an eval-harness regression alert. Need tracing hooks from runtime.
sre-bot: Will add KV metrics and the traffic-ramp automation. Also add a warmup step to populate caches before canary begins.
Leah: Docs timeline: draft howto + billing examples by Thu EOD, final next Tue after reviews.
Zoe: GA decision checklist we agreed on:
- SLA tests green (owner: Marco)
- Billing-smoke completed and invoices sanity-checked (Leah + Finance)
- Canary executed per plan with no rollbacks for 48h at 100% (sre + runtime)
- Runbook and user docs published (Leah)
- Dashboards + regression alerts live (Marco)
If any item fails, hold GA and run rollback playbook.
Marco: Scheduling synthetic runs for tomorrow AM and will paste results here.
Leah: I'll start docs and billing snippets now. Will ping reviewers.
Zoe: Thanks  keep flags in the tickets. Tag me for blockers.
